items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Benny Morten and myself were working for Chick at the Roseland... Benny Carter and Jimmy Harrison for Russell Procope and Benny Martin. So we switched jobs.

ctx.x: The way he hired me, he -- I don't remember exactly how -- I just don't remember the point when he -- when he offered me the job, but this was a period where I call it the Big Trade. The Big Trade was Benny Carter and Jimmy Harrison, Jimmy Harrison the trombone player, they were working for Fletcher at Connie's Inn, and Benny Morten and myself were
working for Chick at the Roseland. So we made a trade. Benny Carter and Jimmy Harrison for Russell Procope and Benny Martin. So we switched jobs. That's what we always called the Big Trade.
